title: Hold one boundary at a time: the data center alone, or the whole chain of a streamed hour
text: Inside the data center, a video hour is near {c[fp-037][text]} Wh on bottom-up accounts and far more on a top-down average, a median text prompt is {c[fp-001][text]} Wh, measured, and an AI video clip is about {c[fp-070][value]} to {c[fp-067][text]} Wh depending on the model.
With the screen and the network counted, an hour of streaming runs from {c[fp-120][text]} to {c[fp-143][value]} Wh by source, all modeled. No source measures a chat hour on this boundary.
